worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.summary: A low, flat flying kick: crouch, spring, and sweep the leg out along a shallow arc. Land it and the target is kicked away; miss and the ankle cracks on the ground, hurting the user. The cleanest, fastest strike in the crash-kick family.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.description.0: The flying kick deals %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type match-up and crits are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.description.1: Leap %1$s blocks, rising at %2$s blocks per tick, diving at %3$s blocks per tick with %4$s blocks per tick of forward drift.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.description.2: Up to %1$s blocks of reach with a %2$s block hit radius; a miss costs %3$s times the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.description.3: Knock the target back %1$s blocks on hit.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.running.on: Running start: more kick power and a longer forward arc (harder to dodge), but a longer wind-up, a heavier self-hurt on a miss and a slightly lower leap.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.running.off: Standing start: quicker to fire, lighter on a miss and a slightly higher leap, but a shorter forward arc and less power.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.growth.0: From level %1$s the kick power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.growth.1: From level %1$s the kick power rises to %2$s and knockback to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.use.0: Deal contact damage with a cheap airborne kick
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.use.1: Kick a target in your face away to open space
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.use.2: Finish a low-health target with one last kick
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.preference.ru: On: run up before the leap, for +8 kick power and a longer forward arc (harder to dodge), at +3 ticks of wind-up and +0.03 self-hurt on a miss. Off: leap from a standstill - faster and lighter on a miss, but shorter and weaker.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.preference.ai: Only fly-kick a target within this distance; closer in otherwise. Larger starts sooner, and lands behind a moving target more often.
On: prefer Jump Kick against targets below a third health to finish them. Off: compete by the shared order only.
worldcombat.skill.jumpkick.description.a: While rising, the kick keeps its landing point on the target's live position; once the dive begins the landing point locks, so a target that moves aside can slip it. Touching any living body on the way down counts as a hit; at the landing point it still picks the nearest enemy within the hit radius, settling only one target; only when all of that fails (including hitting a wall on the way down) is it a miss, costing the user health.
